prs.location: The Elysian is a 600m walk from the South Mall & 700m to Patrick Street in Corks city centre. Kent Train Station (Intercity) is located 1km from the development offering links to Limerick and Dublin. There are extensive bus service routes around the city and fast access to the M8 motorway.

description:
Experience the luxury of living in this wonderful development with spectacular and unrivaled views of Cork City Centre. These luxurious apartments come fully furnished with custom designed interiors and an impression of seclusion while living in this highly central city centre location. 

Key features: 
Residence in Corks most prestigious residential development 
High-quality interior design finish and bespoke furnishings throughout 
Integrated dishwasher and washing machine/dryer 
Generous and bright interiors with extensive storage space 
Spacious bedrooms
Bathrooms with pump assisted showers
Roof terrace and sun room with spectacular views of Cork City 
Efficient central heating system with thermostat control 
Wired for phone, cable and broadband services 
Secure underground parking available at an additional cost 
Audio-visual intercom access system 
Secure fob control for resident areas 
Dedicated management team on site 
After hours management service 
Package delivery storage services 
On-site concierge 7 days a week 

To truly appreciate the uniqueness of this Kennedy Wilson development, viewing is strongly advised. For more information on this property and other Kennedy Wilson rental properties and services please contact us. *Please note that photographs are for marketing purposes. Units are similar but the decor may vary.
